The '''Floater Vehicles Department''' was a government agency on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that had been occupied by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. The department was staffed by [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrats]].<ref name="RPG1" />
